proposals.evidence: Full rātrī gives Torwali žāt, regional rāt and Kotgarhi/Koci rāc in the addendum. These support ẓād/ẓātʰ, ṛat and Kullu raːtʃʊ/ratʰʊə/raːtʃə night with source retroflexion, aspiration and endings preserved. Exact local phonetics and cross-IA transmission remain qualified; unexplained prefixes and second words are excluded. Exact response: ẓād.
